---
description: "Use when editing frontend pages, components, hooks, and Zustand stores."
applyTo: "src/app/**/*.tsx"
---

Frontend rules:
- Keep presentation and business logic separated.
- Ensure loading, empty, success, and error states are handled.
- Preserve accessibility basics: labels, semantic elements, keyboard flow.
- Maintain consistent UI patterns with existing screens.
- Prefer small, composable components over large page-level blocks.
